newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent see modest gains in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent see modest gains in thin trade.

text.p: SIMEX June Brent crude futures rose with its upward momentum seen extending into late Friday's trade, brokers said.
June was last traded at $18.76 per barrel with a total of 22 lots changing hands. July traded 10 cents firmer at $18.74 with 51 lots traded.
Brokers said market technicals were good and healthy gains are likely to follow through until early next week.
Brokers said firm levels on the product futures helped boost prices.
